title: Sentinel MANIFEST.json
description: Machine-readable contract: core read order, term policy, and the injected-bundle byte budget. This schema is the canonical reference and is ENFORCED in CI: tools/check does a fast jq sanity pass, and the lint gate validates MANIFEST.json against this file with check-jsonschema (strict).

name.description: The core must identify itself as 'sentinel'.

core_dir.description: Directory holding the core rule files, relative to the manifest.

required_core_read_order.description: Ordered core files that make up the always-injected bundle.

optional_core_files.description: Core files that exist but are not injected (e.g. BOOTSTRAP, ADAPTERS).

forbidden_core_terms.description: GENERIC, publishable patterns banned anywhere in the tree (e.g. absolute home paths). Private terms must NOT be listed here -- they live in the gitignored local_denylist.

local_denylist.description: Path (relative to the manifest) of the gitignored private denylist. Defaults to tools/forbidden-terms.local.

render_budget_bytes.description: Max bytes for the rendered bundle; tools/check fails over it, warns at >=75%.
